backgrounds.name: Acolyte
backgrounds.description: You devoted yourself to service in a temple, performing rites in honor of the gods.

equipment.A: Calligrapher's Supplies, Book of Prayers, Holy Symbol, 10 sheets of parchment, Robe, 8 GP

backgrounds.description: You began your career in a workshop, learning your trade from the ground up.

backgrounds.description: A master of deception, you survive through wit and guile.

backgrounds.description: You thrive on applause and attention. Trained among traveling performers.

backgrounds.description: You were raised close to the land, tending animals and crops.
